title: ReChisel: Effective Automatic Chisel Code Generation by LLM with Reflection
problem: Chisel (high-level HDL based on Scala) enables more concise and maintainable hardware designs than Verilog, but LLM-based Chisel code generation remains unexplored despite growing interest in LLM-assisted HDL coding.
motivation: Hardware design productivity is critical; Chisel's high-level abstractions provide benefits over traditional Verilog, but lack of LLM tools for Chisel limits adoption and automation opportunities.
method: ReChisel is an LLM-based agentic system incorporating reflection mechanism to iteratively refine generated Chisel code using feedback from compilation and simulation. Includes escape mechanism to break free from non-progress loops, enabling multi-round refinement until correct code is produced.
key_novelty: First LLM-based agentic system for Chisel code generation with reflection-based iterative refinement using compilation and simulation feedback.
contributions: ReChisel: First LLM-based system for Chisel code generation
Escape mechanism to break non-progress loops
Success rate comparable to state-of-the-art Verilog LLM-based systems
Demonstrated effectiveness of iterative refinement for HDL generation

metrics.other: Success rate in Chisel code generation (specific metrics in abstract)

limitations: Performance comparison with Verilog systems indicates potential limitations in absolute success rates; specific metrics not provided in abstract.
primary_theme: Reflection-based LLM agent for Chisel code generation
